issue.title: Agents-tab PNG snapshots capture the '(p)' view hint before it settles: filter_bar_editing and view_picker_five_layouts fail the determinism check under load
issue.description:
Under heavy host load, two Agents-tab PNG snapshots capture a frame that differs between two
runs of the same tree by a single `(p)` key hint, which makes `just fix-tui-screenshots` refuse
to apply goldens with
`determinism verification disagreed with the first capture: verify_hash_mismatch:<golden>`.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Observed while regenerating goldens for an unrelated top-bar change, on a host at load average
28-40 (16 CPUs, other agents running).

- Full `just fix-tui-screenshots` run 2: `verify_hash_mismatch` on
  `agents_filter_bar_editing_120x40.png` and `agents_view_picker_five_layouts_120x40.png`.
- In both, the capture-vs-verify pixel diff is confined to one row of the sub-bar (y ~ 92-115,
  x 585-1092) and the SVG text diff is exactly one text run, `(p)` (the `view:` picker key hint),
  present in one capture and absent in the other, e.g. `-' (p)]'` / `+']'`.
- The same run's other tests were deterministic; the golden itself matched at clean HEAD in a
  later check-only run, so the golden is fine and the frame is captured before the hint settles.
- Fail rate: 2 of 2 full runs under load had at least one flake of this class (the first run also
  flaked in agents_fleet, tracked separately as sase-14b). Not reproduced serially at low load.

Likely cause: the `wait_for_visual_idle` convergence accepts a frame before the `(p)` view hint
has been painted, the same host-load race class as sase-14b. The fix belongs in the tests' wait
predicates (wait for the hint text semantically), not in tolerance settings.

payload.description: Same host-load PNG determinism-verify race class in Agents-tab snapshots, different tests

payload.entry: Superseded by epic sase-17d: the Agents 'view:' chip and its '(p)' picker key hint were deleted by sase-17d.10.1.2 (742c1df38b), and agents_view_picker_five_layouts_120x40.png plus its test were deleted with the p view picker. No '(p)' hint remains in src/sase/ace/tui at 8fd6a054fd, so the flaky text run this task describes can no longer render in agents_filter_bar_editing. Verified by sase-17d.land.

payload.close_reason: sase-17d deck cutover deleted the (p) view hint and the view picker golden
